pick.headline: Three Israelis killed aboard a yacht in Larnaca

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 186, 25 September 1985
evidence.snippet: FBIS DAILY REPORT MIDDLE EAST & SOUTH ASIA REVIEW 25 SEPTEMBER 1985 Palestinian Affairs Two Palestinian gunmen captured an Israeli yacht in Larnaca marina 25 September, killing a woman on board and taking two men hostage, Nicosia radio announced, adding that the area has been cordoned off by police and security forces.
